Copy a caption, copy the image, paste both into the channel.

Poster

1024 × 1280 · 4:5send as photo

Copy image is the one button a browser can refuse: putting a PNG on the clipboard goes through the permission-gated Clipboard API, which is withheld on plenty of local pages. When it says Blocked, use Save PNG and drag the file in — or drag docs/release-notes/v0.20.0-poster.png straight from the repo, which is the same bytes and skips the clipboard entirely. The caption buttons need no clipboard permission, so they are not the ones to worry about here. On a phone: press and hold the poster, then Save to Photos — and press and hold a caption rather than trusting its button — a phone browser is the case least tested here.

English

🎤 SingZ v0.20.0 — when SingZ mishears your song, you get the last word

Fix the words yourself, right down to the syllable. Until now a mis-heard lyric meant listening again and hoping. There's a lyrics editor now — type or paste the real words, drag any word onto the exact instant it's sung, right on the recording's own waveform, or let SingZ line everything up for you in one pass.

Every line carries a little picture of the vocals, so a line that's actually silence — the software imagining words into nothing — shows itself before you even read it.

Correct it once on the computer, and every phone gets the fixed lyrics the next time it syncs.

https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/tag/v0.20.0

Russian

🎤 SingZ v0.20.0 — когда SingZ ослышался, последнее слово за вами

Поправьте слова сами — вплоть до слога. Раньше при неверно расслышанной строке оставалось только слушать заново и надеяться. Теперь в SingZ есть редактор текста: впишите или вставьте настоящие слова, перетащите любое слово точно на момент, где оно спето, — по собственной дорожке записи, — или пусть SingZ выровняет всё сам, за один проход.

У каждой строки теперь есть маленькая картинка вокала под текстом — если строка на самом деле тишина, а не пение, это видно ещё до того, как вы её прочли.

Поправьте один раз на компьютере — и телефон получит исправленный текст при следующей синхронизации.

https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/tag/v0.20.0

Telegram allows 1024 characters on a photo caption and recompresses photos past ~1280 px on the long side — this poster is 1280 on its long side, so sending it as a photo costs nothing. Poster file: docs/release-notes/v0.20.0-poster.png
